stem:
Cadmium ions form complexes with primary amines and with 1,2-diaminoethane.

$$\text{Cd}^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 4\text{CH}_3\text{NH}_2\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{Cd}(\text{CH}_3\text{NH}_2)_4]^{2+}\text{(aq)} \qquad K_{\text{stab}} = 3.6 \times 10^6 \quad \text{equilibrium \textbf{I}}$$

$$\text{Cd}^{2+}\text{(aq)} + 2\text{H}_2\text{NCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2\text{(aq)} \rightleftharpoons [\text{Cd}(\text{H}_2\text{NCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2)_2]^{2+}\text{(aq)} \qquad K_{\text{stab}} = 4.2 \times 10^{10} \quad \text{equilibrium \textbf{II}}$$

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Write an expression for the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, for equilibrium \textbf{I}, and state its units.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Cadmium ions are poisonous and need to be removed from some water supplies. This is often done by adding a complexing agent.

In a sample of ground water the concentration of $\text{Cd}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ is $1.00 \times 10^{-4} \text{mol dm}^{-3}$.

Calculate the concentration of $\text{CH}_3\text{NH}_2\text{(aq)}$ needed to reduce the concentration of $\text{Cd}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ in this dilute solution by a factor of one thousand.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Values for $\Delta H^{\ominus}$ and $\Delta G^{\ominus}$ for equilibria \textbf{I} and \textbf{II}, and the value of $\Delta S^{\ominus}$ for equilibrium \textbf{I}, are given in the table below. All values are at a temperature of $298 \text{ K}$.

| equilibrium | $\Delta H^{\ominus} / \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ | $\Delta G^{\ominus} / \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ | $\Delta S^{\ominus} / \text{J K}^{-1}\text{mol}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| \textbf{I} | $-57.3$ | $-37.4$ | $-66.8$ |
| \textbf{II} | $-56.5$ | $-60.7$ | to be calculated |
parts.text: Suggest a reason why the $\Delta H^{\ominus}$ values for the two equilibria are very similar.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest a reason for the difference between the $\Delta S^{\ominus}$ you have calculated for equilibrium \textbf{II} and that for equilibrium \textbf{I} given in the table.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Which of the two complexes is the more stable? Give a reason for your answer.
